glass: tulip-shaped grappa glass (about 150 ml), chilled, no ice
version: v1.2 (round 4 step 1: Hester's audit v1 wording landed, M1-M7; drink unchanged from v1, round 2, 2026-10-04): a grappa Martini. Nonino single-varietal grappa, young, not wood-aged, recommended (Oxford GRAPPA pdf 936, POLI pdf 1544), with French blanc vermouth steeped one hour with a fresh fig leaf (Flavor Matrix FIG pdf 120: fig trees are grown for the fruit, the leaves are highly aromatic; GRAPES pdf 140 lists figs among the grape's substitutes) and one teaspoon of simple syrup. Stirred 15 s, strained, no garnish. Swept: grappa 37.5-48%, blanc sugar 10-16 g, syrup 50-65 g, syrup 3.75-7.5 ml, vermouth 15-25 ml.
